I also heard a rumour it was a fundamental disagreement between the Effective Altruist group and the ‘effective accelerationist’ group within OpenAI.

The Altruists are focused on AI safety and want to slow down release of models and AI features until they have been properly vetted. The accelerationists want to build and get AI in the hands of the public as fast as possible. The Altruists (of which Ilya is one, apparently) view this as an existential threat to the human race, so were willing to go nuclear and evict Sam (an accelerationist). 

Apparently this split has happened before, with Anthropic formed from former OpenAI Effective Altruist believers.

I don’t know how true this is, but it certainly is interesting

Hear me out. AGI is simple. It is just the user interface which has not yet been developed that combines the specific use cases of gpt4 and adds some probes to securely interact with your local files. That is simple and they can make that in a month. Likely did months ago and are still getting UI elements prepared. ASI is when they can take that previous system and run multiple instances of it at once, like, hundreds of them. Then we have hundreds of tasks being completed inside dozens of dockers in miliseconds. It now learns and executes faster than we can interpret its logs. THIS is what these terms mean. TLDR AGI: A average level employee or servant you can recruit for most jobs - ASI: A cyclone of AGI agents learning and executing faster than we can even see, maybe making twitter posts...Jimmy* cough*

Thus, Discussions follow internally. Members disagree on what to do with this new AGI. Sam begins developing implementations for developers. The team members begin to get uncomfortable with the capabilities and unpredictability, and a divide occurs. Some members want to develop and release this, others want to chill out and test for a while because we only know a fraction of what it can now do. Sam is indirect in his answer as he was still contemplating this himself. Ilya jumps in and pushes for Sam to be replaced and someone Confident in pumping the breaks is found. Sam is surprised by this and the members who were in agreement with him leave with him. Investors rally in confusion as Sam ensures that through Microsoft he still has access to the system. He declines the position after the Investors push the board, and leaves to join microsoft and continue working on the system, same as before, since they are ran on microsoft hardware. Sams team joins him in microsoft and the systems are developed under that umbrella until Satya determines the release. OpenAi remains strong, but focused again on RnD, Sam now leads product development and releases us cool toys like gpts using the systems that Openai Research. No harm, no foul.
